core_thesis: Mercados de previsão podem funcionar como sensores point-in-time; ARGOS só promove risco quando informação adicional demonstra ganho incremental fora da amostra sobre a própria probabilidade agregada. Se o gate falha, o output é abstention/no-trade.
one_line_value_proposition: Observar não é o mesmo que operar: ARGOS transforma informação em risco apenas depois de evidência incremental pré-registrada.

robot_identity.name: ARGOS
robot_identity.meaning: múltiplos sensores observáveis submetidos a gates quantitativos de validação
robot_identity.not_meaning: insider detector, private-information detector, manipulation detector or illegality detector
robot_identity.tagline_primary: Muitos olhos. Risco só com evidência incremental.

story_arc: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed information and can be treated as sensors rather than automatic trading signals.
ARGOS first validates aggregate probability, then asks the harder incremental question: do movement/flow/concentration dynamics add information beyond that aggregate sensor?
The research process deliberately removed complexity before outcomes and froze the confirmatory protocol before labels were opened.
Aggregate probability showed predictive value in the tested earnings/EPS laboratory, but the movement layer failed the incremental H2 gate.
Economic translations also failed promotion, so the pre-registered stop rule preserved C0_NO_TRADE rather than selecting a post-hoc winner.
A performance-blind EUAS audit later showed earnings was an ex-ante defensible first laboratory and identified disciplined future universes without rewriting the frozen result.

GenAI's value was operational and governance-heavy: broad research, reproducible data engineering, structural reduction, preregistration, deterministic execution and preservation of negative evidence under human control.

page_plan.working_title: ARGOS — informação só vira risco depois de sobreviver ao teste
page_plan.single_message: ARGOS treats prediction markets as PIT information sensors and uses abstention as a first-class portfolio decision.
content_blocks: ARGOS identity + many-eyes metaphor
economic mechanism: dispersed information -> prediction-market probability -> incremental movement test -> capital gate
three-state decision: LONG / SHORT / ABSTAIN, with only promoted rules allowed to reach capital
tested laboratory: Polymarket earnings/EPS linked to US individual equities
compact EUAS rationale: earnings #1 among complete-evidence families, score 72, explicitly not a global maximal-asymmetry claim
page_plan.hero_visual: single horizontal Observe -> Validate -> Allocate pipeline with a red stop branch to NO-TRADE

page_plan.single_message: Technical sophistication came from broad mechanism search followed by outcome-blind structural reduction appropriate to the effective sample.
content_blocks: 69 techniques -> 59 Pass-B inputs -> 25 label-free descriptors -> redundancy/data gates -> 6 primary mechanisms
six mechanisms: conditional state, velocity, signed flow, concentration, directional persistence, jump/regime change
M_MOVE_CORE = intercept + M2 slope + 6 movement coefficients; fixed ridge lambda=1; no hyperparameter search
one nonlinear challenger: matrix-profile discord
effective confirmatory sample: 75 OOS events across 54 date clusters; 40-event warm-up
page_plan.hero_visual: funnel / Sankey-like reduction diagram emphasizing removal before outcomes
avoid: pseudo-replication using 12,752 trades as outcome n

page_plan.working_title: O teste podia reprovar o robô — e reprovou H2
page_plan.single_message: M2 remained informative, but the frozen movement layer did not add incremental information and failed every confirmatory promotion gate.
content_blocks: H1 qualitative result: PIT Polymarket probability predictive versus tested free/public baselines
H2 head-to-head: M2_CAL vs M_MOVE_CORE Brier and log loss
paired cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals for incremental metrics
0/3 temporal Brier terciles positive
pre-registered stop rule: no subgroup/threshold/challenger rescue
page_plan.hero_visual: two-metric comparison plus incremental-CI zero line and a compact gate-failure strip

page_plan.working_title: Traduzimos em capital — e o stop rule preservou no-trade
page_plan.single_message: ARGOS was subjected to a separate economic translation with PIT entries/exits, SPY, explicit costs, equal notional sizing and multiplicity; the rule failed, so C0_NO_TRADE remained champion.
content_blocks: two-layer distinction: informational validation vs economic capital test
R1 T-1 / 10 sessions: 108 eligible opportunities, 34 trades, 21 long / 13 short
fixed costs: 20 bps long / 35 bps short round trip
market-adjusted net return per opportunity -0.2050%; CI95 [-0.9719%, +0.5590%]
hit rate 41.18%; Holm p=1.0
C0_NO_TRADE champion; positive diagnostic rules were not promoted
page_plan.hero_visual: backtest protocol strip feeding a compact result card ending in C0_NO_TRADE

page_plan.working_title: O resultado final é uma decisão de pesquisa — e um próximo experimento melhor
page_plan.single_message: The negative result changes the research agenda rather than the story: GenAI helped build a reproducible falsification pipeline, and EUAS defines the next preregistered tests without mining a new winner.
content_blocks: final decision stack: H1 supported; H2 failed; H3/H4/H5 blocked; C0_NO_TRADE
GenAI case 1: data/provenance engineering with live CI validation and fail-closed missingness
GenAI case 2: 69-technique outcome-blind audit and redundancy reduction
GenAI case 3: executable preregistration + deterministic H2 execution + no post-hoc rescue after FAIL
GenAI control loop: propose -> verify/source/execute -> freeze/hash -> accept/reject
EUAS next steps: FDA preferred single-name extension; macro requires rates/index architecture; expand M&A-completion discovery before ranking/promotion

authoring_rules.numeric_precision: round for readability while preserving direction and CI endpoints; source exact values from final_submission_numbers.csv or frozen W1 summaries
authoring_rules.citations: short footnote-style citations only where they strengthen methodological credibility; never link the non-anonymous GitHub repo
authoring_rules.claims_precedence: FST/SF frozen claims > final claim/number registries > W1 report-only overlay > prose
authoring_rules.negative_result_policy: show result, uncertainty, pre-registered consequence and what was not allowed after failure
authoring_rules.space_policy: every block must map to at least one rubric criterion
